title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the 'BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client's data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Please share your resume in English.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account's objectives and the client's initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.

This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

Nesse cenário, estamos construindo novas frentes usando tecnologia avançada, automação inteligente e soluções digitais que vão impulsionar ainda mais o nosso crescimento e transformar a forma como entregamos valor ao nosso cliente/negócio.

Desejável:

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer

LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil

REPortS TO:

R&D Manager

Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.

Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.

Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.

Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.

Education:

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.

Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.

Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.

Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.

Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect

The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Lead Training Consultant - SAP IBP & ePPDS
description:
About Company::

Bristlecone is a supply chain and business analytics advisor, serving customers across a wide range of industries. Rated by Gartner as among the top ten system integrators in the supply chain space, we are uniquely positioned to solve contemporary business problems, with supply chain and analytics focus as our advantage. We have been a trusted partner and advisor to many leading, globally recognized companies such as Applied Materials, Exxon Mobil, Flextronics, LSI Logic, Mahindra, Motorola, Nestle, Palm, Qatar Petroleum, Ranbaxy, Unilever and Whirlpool and many others.

Role Overview:

Language Required- Spanish Speaking

Should be open to travel to Mexico on needed basis

Role Objective

The Lead Training Consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end educational lifecycle of our digital supply chain transformation. This role requires a unique individual who can not only configure SAP IBP and ePPDS modules but also translate complex technical processes into comprehensive training programs for diverse business audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Training Strategy: Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and design a global curriculum covering SAP IBP (Demand, S&OP, Response & Supply) and ePPDS.
  • Content Development: Create high-quality, multi-format training materials including Instructor-Led Training (ILT) decks, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), video tutorials, and interactive eLearning modules.
  • Hands-on Facilitation: Deliver engaging training sessions to Super Users and End Users, utilizing real-world business scenarios in a dedicated training environment.
  • Environment Management: Manage and maintain the SAP training landscape (Sandbox), ensuring master data is refreshed and aligned for practical hands-on labs.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide critical Hypercare support and refresher training post-deployment to ensure high system adoption and user proficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (specifically Order-Based Planning) and ePPDS (embedded Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling) in S/4HANA.
  • Training Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end training delivery for large-scale SAP implementations, from curriculum design to final assessment.
  • Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, and detailed production scheduling.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical users.
  • Certification: SAP IBP or SCM Professional certification is highly preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful execution of the global training calendar within project timelines.
  • High user adoption rates and positive training effectiveness scores.
  • Minimal post-go-live support tickets related to "lack of knowledge" or process errors

title: Sr. Linux System Engineer
description:
Who will you be working with?

In this role you will work our Global Platform Operations in a team of engineers based in Americas.

How will you make a difference?

Wabtec is looking for a new member to join our Global Platform Operations in a team of engineers based in Americas. Our ideal candidate will have a solid technical background in Linux server environment and specifically with knowledge in Hyper V, VMware, Veeam, Scripting and Automation. The successful candidate will have a track record of partnering with technical teams to achieve continuous improvement across our various compute platforms.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or "STEM" majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience in an Enterprise scale engineering or relevant discipline.
  • Advanced understanding of Linux configuration, patching, and security hardening experience.
  • Experience with automating and scripting tasks (Ansible, Terraform, Shell/Bash).
  • Familiarity with IaC in public cloud environment.
  • Familiarity with Virtualization Technologies (VMWare, HyperV).
  • Familiarity with Backup Technologies.
  • Understanding of Basic Networking Concept (TCPI/IP, DNS, DHCP).
  • Experience with Active Directory and User Management.
  • Experience with ticketing and change request processes.
  • Analytical approach to solve complex problems in a complex, large-scale, and multi datacenter environments.
  • Ability to communicate with many IT and non-IT colleagues internationally.
  • Self-starter – requires minimal direction to accomplish goals.
  • Knowledge of Patching Technologies (Tanium, SCCM) - nice to have.
  • Knowledge Storage Technologies a Plus (3PAR, Pure, DellEMC Unity) - nice to have.
  • Advanced knowledge of VEEAM Backup Technologies - nice to have.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Collaborate with Senior IT Staff to optimize server infrastructure performance and assure security in a high availability environment specific to Linux.
  • Play a key role in the automation of our processes, eg. using IaaC or PowerShell both for On-Premises sites, and public cloud (AWS, Azure, OCI).
  • Participate in the research and evaluation of emerging technology, industry, and market trends to assist in operational support.
  • Support the installation, configuration, and operation of the Linux server environment and provide advanced technical knowledge in order to troubleshoot and resolve unique or complex problems in an efficient manner.
  • Collaborate with Cyber team to track and resolve all security vulnerability findings within appropriate timeframes.
  • Contribute to the documentation of our standard procedure.
  • Manage technical projects or programs (renewal of hardware, upgrades of OS and software, integration of external IT environment to our standard, etc.)
  • Contribute to the completeness of our ITIL, and integrity of Infrastructure tools.
  • Contribute to the migration of remote workloads to the cloud or data centers

Ao se juntar a nós, você terá acesso a uma série de benefícios pensados para promover seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento.   • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).

Additional Information

At Wabtec, it's not just about a job - it's about the impact you make. When our people come together, we're Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it's freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
ZTE is looking for Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager

Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company's ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team? Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

title: ANALISTA LOGÍSTICA PL
description:

  • Refeitório na empresa;
  • Transporte Fretado;

  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken); confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based (fully remote)

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English, and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client's go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

description:
Damos as boas-vindas ao universo de experiências Ingresse!

Somos uma empresa global de entretenimento e líder na América Latina, fornecendo tecnologia, soluções e insights para o setor de eventos.

Acreditamos que o verdadeiro valor da vida está nas experiências que vivemos e nas histórias que compartilhamos. Usamos nosso conhecimento em curadoria e tecnologia para trazer não apenas eventos que estão transformando a indústria e a vida das pessoas, mas também inovações para quebrar a mesmice.

Buscamos por alguém que venha atuar na posição de Analista de Dados Sênior (antifraude).

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenhar, manter e otimizar pipelines de ETL/ELT para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de múltiplas fontes (transações, logs, adquirentes e sistemas antifraude), garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Desenvolver queries complexas em SQL, otimizar performance e lidar com grande volume de dados.
  • Utilizar de programação em Python ou R para análise de dados (manipulação de dados, estatística e automação).
  • Modelar, documentar e manter Data Marts analíticos e views consolidadas, assegurando a criação de uma Single Source of Truth para a área de Risco e Prevenção a Fraudes.
  • Implementar e monitorar rotinas de Data Quality, com alertas automatizados para identificar inconsistências, gaps e desvios, atuando proativamente na correção de problemas.
  • Extrair e preparar features robustas e de alta qualidade para os modelos de machine learning de detecção de fraude.
  • Realizar a validação e o monitoramento da performance de modelos de risco e regras antifraude em ambiente de produção, identificando desvios (drift).
  • Criar relatórios de performance e data storytelling para a liderança, quantificando o impacto financeiro de diferentes estratégias.
  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção do stack de dashboards executivos (Looker Studio) para monitoramento de KPIs de fraude, chargeback, MDR e performance de pagamentos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em modelagem de dados e construção de data marts analíticos.

title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript. Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures, including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Payroll Specialist/ 80% English/ Experience with Obligations
description:
If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution - you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.

We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.

Responsible for the entire internal payroll process (entries, checks, and payments);

Review of charges (INSS, FGTS, IRRF) until payment;

Review and control of the delivery of ancillary obligations (DET, DIRBI, CPRB, CRF, Sistemas S, etc.);

Calculation of severance pay;

Relationship with ADP;

Scheduling and payment of admission, dismissal, and periodic exams;

Generation and verification of payroll accounts and accounting provisions;

Handling and delivery of documents related to audits, inspections, and legal proceedings;

Payment of benefits and apportionment by area/class;

Provision of information related to labor routines for employees in Brazil and Chile;

Issuance of monthly data analysis reports.

Solid experience in payroll processing for Brazil and Chile, with knowledge of local labor laws and tax regulations.

Experience with overtime, on-call shifts, and variable compensation.

Attention to detail, ensuring payroll accuracy and compliance.

Ability to collaborate with HR, Finance, and external partners (ADP) to solve problems and improve processes.

Good communication skills and a proactive mindset.

Willingness to stay up to date on legal updates and payroll best practices.

Key Experience

E-Social, accounting, annual reconciliations, among others.

Knowledge of labor and tax legislation.

Desirable knowledge of Power BI.

Desirable knowledge of the ADP tool.

Desirable knowledge of the Workday tool.

Completed higher education in Administration, Accounting, Human Resources, or related area. Mandatory and very important to have experience with Obligations in Brazil, we need some good expertice in this area.

title: Account Manager
description:
Our client, an iGaming Game provider is seeking an experienced Account Manager based in LATAM, fluent in both Portuguese and English, with a strong background in the iGaming or gambling industry.

This role is ideal for a professional who is passionate about building long-term partner relationships, driving customer engagement, and working closely with internal and external stakeholders. The Account Manager will play a key role in managing client interactions, monitoring partner performance, supporting customer retention, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, results-driven, and open to traveling for business trips and industry events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for partners by providing ongoing support, answering queries, and resolving account-related issues. Assist with technical inquiries, communicate new features and promotions, and help resolve operational challenges.
  • Drive the successful launch of new game titles by actively promoting upcoming releases and securing optimal placement within partners' casino lobbies.
  • Monitor partner activity on the platform by analyzing player numbers, betting volumes, gameplay frequency, and performance trends, identifying opportunities for growth or additional support.
  • Focus on sales growth and customer retention through personalized commercial offers, promotional campaigns, and special initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, design, finance, integration management, and technical support to ensure smooth partner operations.
  • Represent the company and present products and services during business trips, conferences, and networking events.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience as an Account Manager within the iGaming or gambling industry (experience with casino game providers is an advantage).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain trusted partnerships.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-focused.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Full professional fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel for business meetings and industry events.
  • Proficiency with digital tools and platforms such as HubSpot, Jira, and Confluence.

Salary & Conditions

  • Salary maximum of BRL 15,000 Gross monthly
  • Sales Bonus
  • KPI Bonus
  • Fully Remote as a contractor

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior SAP (ABAP / SAPUI5 / CAP
description:
Garantir a estabilidade operacional das soluções SAP, atuando na manutenção, correção e evolução controlada de aplicações ABAP, Fiori/SAPUI5 e serviços CAP na SAP BTP. O profissional será responsável por diagnosticar e resolver incidentes com celeridade, conduzir análises de causa raiz, implementar correções definitivas (fixes e refatorações), e assegurar observabilidade, segurança e desempenho das integrações e aplicações em produção.

Responsabilidades

  • Suportar, desenvolver e otimizar objetos (programas, classes, funções), serviços OData/REST via Gateway, BAPIs, IDocs e ALV; implementar extensões S/4 (In?App/Side?by?Side).
  • Refatorar código legado seguindo Clean ABAP; aplicar ATC/Code Inspector, unit tests e tuning (SQL Monitor/SAT); conduzir code reviews e assegurar quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Suportar e construir apps Fiori/UI5 (freestyle/Elements) com TypeScript/ES6, i18n, acessibilidade e OPA/QUnit; projetar e desenvolver serviços CAP (CDS, Node.js/Java) com multi?tenant, XSUAA, destinations, eventing e jobs.
  • Orquestrar integrações (SAP CPI/Integration Suite, SFTP/queues, webhooks) garantindo observabilidade (logs/métricas/tracing); atuar em AMS com análise de causa raiz, correções permanentes e participação em rotinas executivas de riscos/issues.

Requisitos

  • 7+ anos em SAP ABAP (ECC/S/4HANA) com entregas em ambientes produtivos complexos.
  • 2+ anos com SAPUI5/Fiori, CAP na SAP BTP (CDS, Node.js/Java), XSUAA, destinations e integração com CPI.
  • Vivência com APIs OData/REST, Gateway, CPI/Integration Suite, S/4 Extensions e devops/CI?CD.
  • Prática com ATC/Code Inspector, ABAP Unit e testes UI (OPA/QUnit).
  • Experiência com ITSM/ChaRM e sustentação AMS.
  • Inglês intermediário para interação com equipes globais.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP (ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori, BTP/Integration Suite).
  • Experiência em Clean ABAP, performance tuning (SQL Monitor/SAT), CDS Views avançadas, Event Mesh, Kyma.
  • Conhecimento funcional em HR/EHS e integrações com terceiros

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.

They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.

Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.

This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world's largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world's best financial institutions.

About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective 'Lines of Business' (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You'll build cutting-edge solutions for the world's largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

• Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs

The Ideal candidate

• Hands-on experience with C# - including experience in electronic trading platforms

• Experience with unit testing and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge on one of the following: Equities; FX; Rates; Credit; and Derivatives is a plus

• In-depth knowledge of multithreading, memory management, and low-latency systems

• Solid understanding of design & architecture principles, common data structures and algorithms complexity

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, tools like Intellij, JIRA and Confluence and version control in Git

• Fluency in English (both written and spoken)

Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We're in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Analista de Processos Metalúrgicos
description:

O Grupo Maringá atua nos segmentos da Siderurgia e do Sucroenergético. Produzimos Ferroliga de Manganês, Cana-de-Açúcar, Açúcar, Etanol e Energia, contribuindo para o provimento de aço, alimentos, biocombustível e energia, elementos fundamentais para o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil e do Mundo.

A Maringá Ferro-Liga é a maior produtora da América do Sul e a Usina Jacarezinho foi avaliada em 2020 como a Melhor Empresa do setor de Açúcar e Etanol no ranking Melhores e Maiores da Revista Exame.

Resumo do Cargo: O Analista/Engenheiro em Processos Metalúrgicos é responsável por realizar estudos, análises e controles estatísticos referentes ao processo de produção de Ferro-Ligas de Manganês. Este profissional também é encarregado de propor novos processos de produção de Ferro-Ligas.

  • Analisar os métodos e processos de produção.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas e gargalos nos processos de produção existentes.
  • Desenvolver e implementar sistemas de produção otimizados.
  • Garantir a conformidade com padrões de qualidade.

  • Observar os processos de produção para garantir que os ferro-ligas sejam processadas de acordo com as especificações.
  • Planejar e gerenciar o descarte e reciclagem de resíduos provenientes dos processos metalúrgicos.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos processos de produção.
  • Realizar estudos e análises estatísticas dos processos de produção.
  • Propor novos processos de produção de ferro-ligas de manganês.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tecnologias e tendências na indústria metalúrgica.
  • Treinar e orientar outros membros da equipe sobre os processos de produção.

  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas de segurança e saúde ocupacional.

  • Gerenciar a documentação técnica relacionada aos processos de produção.
  • Participar de feiras e conferências da indústria para se manter atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e tecnologias.

title: Sales Manager [Affiliates]
description:

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Senior - Delphi
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

Nossa tecnologia dita o ritmo do mercado. Afinal, 25% do PIB brasileiro passa pelos softwares presentes em mais de 40 mil empresas clientes da TOTVS.

Para que isso aconteça precisamos ser ágeis, pois as coisas aqui acontecem em uma velocidade acima da média. No nosso dia-dia, aprendemos muito e muito rápido, em um ambiente leve, divertido e desafiador. Nosso time de tecnologia tem a ousadia para colocar todo esse aprendizado e conhecimento em prática. Assim, transformando todos os setores da economia por meio da tecnologia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;

  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;

  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções.

REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de aplicações através do Delphi;
  • Desenvolvimento de objetos para banco de dados ORACLE(PL/SQL);
  • Ferramenta de controle de versão GIT;
  • Experiência na criação de API REST;
  • Conhecimento da framework Horse;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Orientação a Objetos;
  • Testes unitários (DUnit);
  • Diferencial: conhecimento nas ferramentas: DevExpress, Report Builder, componentes BD e ACBr;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento:
  • Clean Code;
  • Programação Defensiva;
  • SOLID;
  • Design Patterns;
  • MVC;
  • Conhecimento em métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software.

title: Gerente de Relacionamento de Rede I - Postos
description:
Edenred é uma plataforma digital líder em serviços e pagamentos e a companhia diária para as pessoas no trabalho, conectando mais de 850.000 clientes corporativos, 50 milhões de usuários, 2 milhões de comerciantes parceiros em 46 países por meio de 4 linhas de negócios:

• ACQUIRING: soluções para comerciantes

Estamos no centro de uma rede virtuosa que agrega valor aos seus clientes:

• Empresas e setor público, preocupados em ser empregadores atraentes, motivando suas equipes e otimizando seu desempenho

• Funcionários e cidadãos, que apreciam a simplicidade e conveniência de nossas soluções de pagamento para tornar suas vidas mais fáceis

• Comerciantes (restaurantes, lojas, postos de gasolina, etc.) que buscam aumentar sua receita, fidelizar seus clientes e tornar suas transações mais seguras

Nossos 10.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos, mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar

Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo. Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionários. Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos

Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor

Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você!

  • Gestão de Carteira: Gerenciar o portfólio de Postos Credenciados Edenred, com foco em estratégias de renegociação, rentabilização e retenção.
  • Expansão Estratégica: Atuar ativamente na expansão da rede através de novos credenciamentos estratégicos.
  • Vendas e Consultoria: Impulsionar a venda de produtos e serviços na rede, atuando como um consultor de negócios para elevar a performance operacional e financeira dos parceiros.
  • Fidelização e NPS: Executar a Proposta de Valor Edenred, garantindo o crescimento do NPS e a fidelização dos consumidores finais.
  • Interface Comercial: Atuar como elo estratégico entre Postos Credenciados e o Time Comercial para implantação de contratos, geração de leads e negociação de preços de combustíveis.
  • Ponto Focal: Ser a referência de contato e suporte entre o posto credenciado e a companhia.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Comercial: Sólido histórico em gestão de carteira, vendas consultivas e negociações complexas.
  • Foco em Resultados: Orientação para metas de retenção, rentabilidade e expansão de mercado.
  • Perfil Consultivo: Capacidade de analisar indicadores de negócio para propor melhorias financeiras aos parceiros.
  • Habilidades de Relacionamento: Facilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas (comercial, operacional e clientes) e gerir conflitos.
  • Visão de Mercado: Conhecimento em negociação de combustíveis e dinâmica de postos de serviços (desejável).

title: Controller Financeiro
description:
A posição de Controller Financeiro será responsável por liderar o planejamento, controle e análise financeira da empresa, garantindo governança, eficiência operacional e suporte estratégico às decisões de negócio. O profissional atuará diretamente no segmento de construção civil e incorporação, com foco em empreendimentos MCMV, exigindo forte conhecimento das regras do programa, modelos de financiamento e particularidades do fluxo de caixa do setor.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o planejamento financeiro, incluindo orçamento anual (budget), forecast e análises de variação.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar fluxos de caixa operacionais e de obras, garantindo aderência aos cronogramas físico-financeiros.
  • Gerenciar indicadores financeiros e operacionais (margem, VGV, TIR, payback, custo por m2, curva ABC, etc.).
  • Controlar e revisar orçamentos de obras, custos diretos e indiretos, medições e desvios.
  • Implementar e aprimorar controles internos, políticas e procedimentos financeiros.
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade econômica de novos empreendimentos, com foco em MCMV.
  • Acompanhar contratos de financiamento, repasses, medições e relacionamento com agentes financeiros (Caixa, bancos privados).
  • Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis, fiscais e regulatórias aplicáveis ao setor.
  • Liderar processos de fechamento contábil e gerencial, assegurando acuracidade das informações.
  • Apoiar a diretoria na tomada de decisão por meio de relatórios, dashboards e análises estratégicas.
  • Supervisionar equipes de controladoria, contabilidade, custos e financeiro (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada em controladoria no setor de construção civil/incorporação.
  • Conhecimento profundo do programa MCMV, suas faixas, regras de financiamento e repasse.
  • Domínio de orçamento de obras, curva S, composição de custos e sistemas de gestão (Sienge).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e domínio de Excel/Power BI.

title: Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica ou Produção;
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção mecânica industrial;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, pneumáticos, redutores, agitadores, bombas, motores, transportadores, caldeiras ou equipamentos industriais similares;
  • Conhecimento em sistema de gestão de manutenção SAP (PM);
  • Vivência em planejamento e controle da manutenção (PCM);
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes diretas e terceiras, incluindo análises de performance da equipe, avaliações de desempenho e feedbacks;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de manutenção (RCM, TPM, análise de falhas);
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de manutenção e ferramentas de melhoria contínua;
  • Noções de gestão de contratos e orçamentos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Araucária/PR, de segunda a sexta em horário administrativo, mas com disponibilidade para gerir equipe que trabalha em turnos.

Serão considerados como diferenciais:

  • Certificações em TPM, RCM ou confiabilidade;
  • Especialização em Manutenção ou Gestão Industrial;
  • Experiência profissional em empresas com processos industriais contínuos e de batelada, e segmento químico.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar o time de manutenção e garantir o planejamento das atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, pelas equipes diretas e terceiras, nos equipamentos mecânicos assegurando as análises e diagnósticos das falhas;
  • Participar no desenvolvimento de planos de manutenção mecânica preventiva e preditiva, contribuindo e codificando sistemas, conjuntos mecânicos e componentes;
  • Pesquisar no mercado novos produtos e desenvolver fornecedores de serviços de manutenção mecânica, realizando avaliação técnica e análise de custo x benefício x atendimento a requisitos legais;
  • Otimizar os processos de manutenção, por meio da definição de estratégias de estoque de peças e equipamentos sobressalentes, aplicando ações corretivas às anormalidades detectadas pelo setor produtivo e de manutenção preditiva e sensitiva (inspeções);
  • Contribuir no cumprimento de normas (NR12 e NR13), metodologias de testes, padrões e procedimentos técnicos e operacionais, contendo as especificações técnicas necessárias à execução e implantação dos projetos;
  • Planejar, programar e acompanhar tecnicamente as instalações de novas máquinas e equipamentos, para melhor adequação de layout e instalações, incluindo o acompanhamento e gestão de projetos de investimentos (CAPEX);
  • Garantir a implementação e aplicação das ferramentas de segurança preventivas e de controle junto as equipes de manutenção e das empresas terceiras sob sua gestão;
  • Controlar custos, avaliar e analisar a provisão de verba anual, assegurando a realização de reparos, reformas, substituição de peças, máquinas, equipamentos e circuitos painéis, conforme necessidade e programação.

Com uma equipe líder do setor composta por especialistas internos em energia, somos uma subsidiária integral da Canadian Solar Inc. e atuamos como o braço global da Canadian Solar para desenvolvimento e serviços de energia.

Título do Cargo: Técnico de Campo

Departamento: O&M (Operação e Manutenção)

Local: Ilha Solteira (UFV Pereira Barreto)

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Possuir alto nível de treinamento e conscientização em segurança, cumprindo todas as normas de saúde e segurança e as políticas da empresa.
  • Solucionar diariamente problemas nos sistemas do projeto para atender às metas de disponibilidade (uptime).
  • Compreender as metas horárias e diárias de produção do parque solar. Caso haja risco de não cumprimento, executar um plano de correção ou escalar a situação.
  • Realizar manutenções de rotina (manutenções preventivas, testes de partida, etc.) nos equipamentos e determinar quando e que tipo de manutenção é necessária antes de escalar problemas ou questões.
  • Identificar problemas potenciais e sugerir mudanças ou ações corretivas.
  • Trabalhar com outros membros da equipe de O&M, subcontratados e demais áreas para melhorar continuamente o desempenho do sistema, a qualidade do produto e a redução de custos de manutenção.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar falhas em diversos sistemas de parques solares, como arranjos fotovoltaicos (PV), inversores, painéis de manobra (switchgear), transformadores, disjuntores, sistemas de comunicação, equipamentos de CFTV, entre outros.
  • Seguir os cronogramas de manutenção e realizar manutenções preventivas dos equipamentos.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de procedimentos operacionais padrão para manutenção de equipamentos, operações e treinamentos.
  • Apoiar o comissionamento e os testes dos projetos, fornecendo conhecimento técnico especializado.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades do negócio sejam realizadas com os mais altos padrões éticos e em conformidade com o Código de Conduta Empresarial da Canadian Solar Solutions.
  • Cumprir todas as normas e políticas ambientais, de saúde e segurança.
  • Executar outras atividades e projetos conforme designado.

REQUISITOS

  • Formação técnica completa em Eletrotécnica (nível médio).
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos como técnico de manutenção no setor de energias renováveis (solar, eólica ou similar).
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com inversores Ingeteam Series B ou C.
  • Experiência em manutenção e operação de equipamentos de média e alta tensão (MT e AT), incluindo cubículos, seccionadoras e equipamentos similares.
  • Sólida experiência em diagnóstico e reparo de máquinas e equipamentos elétricos.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de plantas, diagramas elétricos, funcionais, lógicos, esquemas, desenhos técnicos, manuais, especificações técnicas e diagramas de fibra óptica.
  • Certificações NR10 e NR10 SEP válidas.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas computacionais e redes será considerado um diferencial.
  • Certificação de operador ONS será um diferencial.
  • Forte ética de trabalho, boa capacidade de trabalho em equipe e atitude positiva para atuação em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar fora do horário comercial (7h às 17h), incluindo atendimento a emergências, trabalho noturno e aos finais de semana, quando necessário.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens por períodos prolongados, ocasionalmente de até uma semana.
  • CNH categoria B válida no Brasil, sem restrições.
